text:
maya: Quick update — Hosted Toolkit (tool-calling + streaming SDK) is GA for hosted customers as of today. Docs, migration guide, and console flags are live. :tada:

devon: Huge — congrats team! Where's the migration guide link?

maya: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted-toolkit-ga (internal link). Key notes in thread below — please skim: breaking surface is tiny but there are a couple of opt-in flags.

tom: TL;DR from infra: new endpoint /v1/toolkit-stream supports streaming + tool-call frames, authenticates with the same API key, and defaults to the new runtime that has lower tail latency for short chat turns. Backwards compatibility: existing /v1/chat endpoints continue to work.

alicia: Ops/Support notes: we turned on smart-routing for GA to favor low-latency pools. If you hit 429s, retry with the header `X-Redwood-Fallback: model=compatible-quant`. We also enabled canary keys for a small subset of accounts — we'll widen over next 48h.

devon: Any deprecations?

maya: Not immediate. We will deprecate the old streaming-toolcall beta path `/v1/stream-tool` in ~90 days, but only after a migration window and automated redirects. Migration guide has a small code snippet: 

```
// old
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-tool \n  -d '{"model":"open-mosaic-7b","prompt":"..."}'

// new
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolkit-stream \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-toolkit-7b","prompt":"...","tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{...}}]}'
```

alicia: Support playbook updated: run `support playbook hosted-toolkit-ga` in shared-runbooks for common errors. Also monitoring dashboards already have a GA tab (Latency P50/P95/P99, Error rate by route).

sre-bot: deploy-bot: release/hosted-toolkit-ga -> production completed at 2026-03-22T16:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

tom: DevEx note: the JS & Python SDKs have a `toolkit` client now. Example: `from redwood import ToolkitClient` — streaming helpers included. If you're using function calling, you'll need to upgrade to SDK v1.8+.

devon: Are there rate limit changes we should be aware of?

alicia: Limits are same by default. Dedicated customers can request higher per-route qps. We added token-level logging for Toolkit calls to help debug cost regressions.

maya: Runbook for internal teams: 1) Announce to customers (use the template in Marketing Drive). 2) If you're on Support/SE, check canary assignments and flag any migration blockers. 3) Engineering: watch the GA dashboards for first 72h — we'll have a daily sync 10:00 PST.

devon: I'll post the customer announcement in #customer-success and ping the selected pilot customers.

tom: Small gotcha we found in staging: older models without tool-call hooks will return a single non-streamed response even on toolkit-stream — SDKs handle this, but call it out in the docs.

maya: Thanks — appreciate the quick work everyone. If you need a short blurb for your teams/customers, use this: "Redwood Hosted Toolkit GA: reliable streaming + tool-calling with lower latency and easier migration paths. See console for details."

alicia: Filed a follow-up ticket to add an alert for unexpected increase in synchronous fallback rates. (#INT-4124)

devon: :thumbsup: will coordinate the customer emails.

maya: Closing note — we'll run a recorded lunch-and-learn tomorrow 11:30 PST for anyone who wants a demo. RSVP in the calendar event.
